# Cressida Lindsay

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v3 c6 P0](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0000), [v3 c4 P20](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0020)</sub>
- **Origin:** Harborough, Nova Scotia  <sub>[v3 c4 P32](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0032)</sub>
- **Role:** Student at Wexcombe College  <sub>[v3 c5 P0](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0000), [v3 c5 P3](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0003)</sub>
- **Titles:** Sophomore  <sub>[v3 c16 P4](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0004)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Cressy  <sub>[v3 c4 P28](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0028)</sub>

## Appearance

Cressida possesses a striking, uneven, and captivating beauty, with plump cheeks carrying a warm tone beneath dark, curiously angled eyebrows. She has plush, large dark eyes and satiny hair resembling brown nuts, paired with uneven, red rose-colored lips. She dresses stylishly in fine clothing, such as a dull pink straw hat adorned with golden-brown poppies and a prominent striped cap and sweater in Wexcombe colors.

_Sources: [v3 c6 P6](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0006), [v3 c4 P20](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0020)_

## Personality

Cressida is an entertaining, affectionate, and highly charming young woman who is completely free of snobbery despite her elite background. She is prone to chronic indecisiveness, unable to keep secrets, and frequently dramatic about her moods and romantic misadventures. Although she presents herself as a somewhat foolish, fun-loving infant who adores social life, sports, and having numerous suitors, she possesses a keen intellect and deep capacity for genuine affection and devotion.

_Sources: [v3 c6 P6](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0006), [v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 c5 P3](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0003), [v3 c7 P10](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0010), [v3 c7 P11](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0011), [v3 c4 P26](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0026), [v3 c4 P36](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0036)_

## History

After enrolling at Wexcombe College, Cressida met Nell Harcourt and Honora Hollis at an ancient graveyard in Portmaris, instantly initiating a close friendship with them. Coming from an elite family background, her social standing and charm opened doors to every clique and club at the college, where she brought Nell and Honora into her social circle. In her academic pursuits, she excelled alongside Nell and Hugh Carrow, topping the Freshman classes during Christmas examinations. She entertained multiple romantic suitors, notably corresponding regularly with Hector and Orlando, though her efforts to attract Hugh Carrow proved unrequited. Later, during her Sophomore year, she moved into Tabby's Place alongside Nell, Honora, and Mabel, deeply admiring the homelike atmosphere they established together.

_Sources: [v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 c5 P3](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0003), [v3 c5 P5](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0005), [v3 c16 P0](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0000), [v3 c7 P0](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0000), [v3 c4 P19](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0019), [v3 c4 P28](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0028)_
